summary: Restated the Collect's intercessoribus and intercessionibus as two variant readings with the witnesses of each and no assigned priority, after reading the apostles' prayer the Collect adapts in the Leonine (Feltoe, image-read) and Gelasian (Wilson, OCR checked on page images) Sacramentaries, searching the whole library for the Collect, quoting Ménard without reading 'prior lectio' as older, and correcting interpretations.md, the Durandus, Sarum, PL 78 and PL 151 binding contexts and their disposition rows; the advisories were also answered (Rabanus's Mt 11:28 comment is shown to be Jerome's, PL 26 col. 75, and his source labels are described as printed). This dispatch contributed the Leonine and Gelasian readings, the finding that the 'Mozarabic' hit is the Monte Suavicino sacramentary reprinted in PL 85, and the identification of Jerome as the source of Rabanus's unlabelled comment.
